//: SD §QD-1's thirteen project-specific Semgrep rules, enumerated WHERE THEY BLOCK. decisions.md OD-61: SD §QD-4's PR row makes 'Semgrep project rules' blocking and lists none, while §QD-1 names thirteen; T-133 shipped exactly one and invented nothing. This file is T-005's triage. `subject` is SD §QD-1 verbatim — do not reword it. `ruleId` is the id in .semgrep.yml when the rule is INSTALLED and null otherwise. `owner` names the ticket that owns the SUBJECT; `installingTicket` names the ticket that will ship the RULE, and null means no ticket owns it yet — which is the finding, not an omission.
//spec: software-design.md §QD-1, 'Project-specific Semgrep rules that fail CI (this list is the institutional memory of the design)'.

rules.subject: watchPosition anywhere
rules.owner: frontend-developer — apps/web, apps/admin, packages/ui are the only places a geolocation API can be called

rules.subject: any in packages/policy
rules.owner: T-133 (platform-infrastructure) installed it; the rule's scope is SD §DH-2 and T-024's gate requires it

rules.subject: hard-coded commission constants (0.08, 0.09, 2.49) outside market_config reads
rules.owner: T-087 / T-088 (backend-booking-payments) — packages/pricing owns commission. Named in decisions.md OD-61 as 'the pricing rule is T-088'

rules.subject: import from 'stripe' outside the adapter
rules.owner: T-094 (backend-booking-payments) — the Stripe Connect adapter is the only legitimate import site

rules.subject: OFFSET in a query
rules.owner: tech-lead — the search and listing queries (SD §PERF: keyset, not offset)

rules.subject: PII-shaped field names in logger calls
rules.owner: T-119 (qa-verification) owns the PII pattern set (SD §SEC-I5); the logger call sites are tech-lead's

rules.subject: .passthrough() on a Zod schema
rules.owner: T-022 (tech-lead) — packages/contracts is where every Zod schema lives

rules.subject: a controller method with no policy decorator
rules.owner: T-024 / T-025 (fullstack-safety) own the policy layer; the controllers are apps/core's

rules.subject: use of --color-trust-verified outside CredentialRow
rules.owner: frontend-developer — packages/ui owns the token and the component

rules.subject: arithmetic on a MinorUnits type inside packages/ui
rules.owner: T-023 (tech-lead) DEFERRED this rule — recorded in decisions.md OD-61; packages/ui is frontend-developer's

rules.subject: a float/number money column in a migration
rules.owner: tech-lead — db/migrations/**. gate:migration-lint (T-021) already reads every migration and is the cheaper home for this one than Semgrep
